regions.today: Bright and breezy today with a mix of cloud and sunny spells. Largely dry with some well scattered showers, mainly in the northern half of the province. The showers will die out before nightfall. Highest temperatures of 15 to 19 degrees and warmest in the south. Moderate to fresh and gusty southwest to west winds will ease later.
regions.tonight: Dry tonight with a mix of cloud and clear spells. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 11 degrees, with light to moderate southwest to west winds, easing further overnight.
regions.tomorrow: Some bright or sunny spells at first on Sunday, but cloud will build from the southwest through the day. Most parts will stay dry but the odd spot of drizzle in possible during the late afternoon and evening. Highest temperatures of 15 to 18 degrees, with light westerly or variable breezes becoming southerly.
regions.solar_uv: Low to moderate today and on Sunday.
